title: OverSire reviews
description: The review gate (OVERSIRE-365). An agent ends a task with commits in its worktree group .wt/<key>, or with a plan. The daemon of the session machine finds each review, computes the diffs, keeps the pending comments and the rounds, sends a submitted batch to the session, and merges locally. It never pushes. Routes: /v1/reviews. Dates are ISO 8601 UTC.

Key.description: The item key in upper case, for example SLING-170. The group of a code review is .wt/<key in lower case>.

Kind.description: code: the commits of a worktree group. plan: the plan of a Plan session.

ReviewState.description: ready: your turn. waiting: a session of the key works. conflict: a merge or a rebase stopped on a conflict. merged: the merge is done.

MergeMode.description: fastForward: the base did not move. rebase: the base moved and git merge-tree finds no conflict. conflict: git merge-tree finds a conflict.

SessionState.description: The session of the key. idle: it waits for input, a submit goes now. working: a submit waits for the end of the turn. ended: a submit starts a new session in the same place. none: the daemon knows no session of the key.

profile.description: The OverSire agent name of the session.

canSend.description: The daemon can type a prompt into the session.

ReviewRepo.description: One repo of a group that has a worktree. A symlink in the group is not a ReviewRepo.

name.description: The folder name in the root, for example cli.

branch.description: The branch of the worktree, the key in lower case.

base.description: The branch of the primary checkout.

ahead.description: Commits of branch that base does not have.

behind.description: Commits of base that branch does not have.

dirty.description: The worktree has uncommitted or untracked files.

commits.description: The commits of branch that base does not have, newest first, at most 50.

items.description: The keys of the Item: lines of the message.

title.description: The title of the plan, or the subject of the first commit. The app shows the tracker title when it has one.

pending.description: The pending comments, not submitted yet.

root.description: The absolute path of the workspace root.

group.description: The group folder relative to root, for example .wt/sling-170. Absent for a plan.

subitems.description: The keys of the sub-items, from the Item: lines of the commits.

note.description: The note of the last hand-off (oversire review ready --note).

NotPushed.description: A base branch with local commits that its upstream does not have.

items.description: The item keys that the commits name: in the message, a trailer Item: KEY or a merged branch.

FileStatus.description: A added, M modified, D deleted, R renamed.

oldPath.description: The old path of a rename.

untracked.description: The file is not committed. The merge does not take it.

viewedStale.description: The file changed after the reviewer marked it viewed. Then viewed is false.

old.description: The line number on the base side. Absent for add.

new.description: The line number on the branch side. Absent for del.

text.description: The line without the +, - or space mark and without the line end.

header.description: The text after the second @@, often the enclosing function.

FileDiff.description: The answer of GET /v1/reviews/{key}/diff?repo=&path=. git diff --unified=3 base...branch, or the full text of an untracked file. With `context=full`: the whole file, and `full` is true.

truncated.description: The diff has more than 3000 lines, or more than 20000 lines when `full` is true. hunks holds the first lines up to that limit.

full.description: The daemon sent the whole file as one hunk (context=full). Absent from an older daemon.

CodeAnchor.description: A line, or the lines from..line, of one file. side old is a line of the base.

CommentState.description: pending: in the batch, not sent. submitted: sent in a round. answered: the agent replied.

round.description: The round of the comment. A pending comment has the next round.

excerpt.description: The code lines or the block heading of the anchor, kept when the comment was made.

reply.description: The answer of the agent (oversire review reply).

Delivery.description: sent: typed into the idle session. queued: the session works, the prompt goes at the end of its turn. newSession: a new session in the same place. none: no prompt (approve).

session.description: The DaemonSession id that got the prompt.

error.description: Why the prompt did not go.

answeredAt.description: The agent handed off again after the round.

PlanDoc.description: The plan of a Plan session, split at each ## heading. The body of PUT /v1/reviews/{key}/plan (loopback only).

version.description: 1 for the first plan. Each new plan of the key adds 1.

root.description: The folder of the Plan session.

subitems.description: The sub-items that the plan made, in order.

ReviewDetail.description: The answer of GET /v1/reviews/{key}. ?kind=plan for the plan review of a key that also has code.

CommentDraft.description: The body of POST /v1/reviews/{key}/comments. HTTP 201 gives the ReviewComment.

CommentEdit.description: The body of PATCH /v1/reviews/{key}/comments/{id}. HTTP 409 for a comment that is not pending.

CommentReply.description: The body of POST /v1/reviews/{key}/comments/{id}/reply (loopback only): the answer of the agent.

SubmitReview.description: The body of POST /v1/reviews/{key}/submit. All pending comments become one round. The answer is the ReviewRound.

postToTracker.description: The app posts the round as one tracker comment. The daemon has no tracker token.

launch.description: The agent for a new session when the session ended. Absent: the agent of the last session.

ReviewReady.description: The body of POST /v1/reviews/{key}/ready (loopback only): the agent hands off.

root.description: The workspace root, when the daemon cannot find the group from its repos.

MergeRequest.description: The body of POST /v1/reviews/{key}/merge. The app sets Done on the item and its sub-items. HTTP 409 when a check fails.

removeGroup.description: Remove the worktrees, the branches and the links of the group after all repos merge.

result.description: skipped: the repo has no commits to merge, or another repo failed. A repo that merged before the failure goes back to its old base and is skipped.

head.description: The base head after the merge.

MergeResult.description: All or none: after a conflict each base is back at its head from before the merge.

ReviewEvent.description: The WebSocket frame {type: review} of a change. A hint: the app gets the data with GET.
